notes.title: "Tank Arena" Update Announcement for September 22 - Version 6.5.0 Is Here
notes.content: [p]"Tank Arena" is scheduled to undergo server maintenance from 15:00 on September 22 to update to version 6.5.0. The update is expected to take approximately 6 hours. Thank you for your understanding and support![/p][p][/p][p]I. New Chief Domination Gameplay[/p][p]To enhance competition within single-branch vehicles, this update introduces the new Chief Domination mode (limited-time event). Engage in Brawl battles using single-branch vehicles to earn Chief Domination Honor, vehicle/equipment upgrade materials, and compete for server-wide rankings (reset monthly). Exclusive titles await top performers![/p][p]Gameplay Details:[/p][p]1. Open Times: Daily 10:00-14:00 and 20:00-22:00.[/p][p]2. Rules:[/p][p]① Vehicles are divided into three types: Tanks (MLRS), AFVs, and Helis. Each match allows 6 players.[/p][p]② Pre-set three same-branch vehicles. Enter the battlefield in sequence—when destroyed, the next vehicle deploys. Battle ends when all vehicles are destroyed or opponents are defeated (or when time expires).[/p][p]③ Battle Score is calculated based on performance (damage, kills, etc.). Rankings determine points: Top 4 gain points, bottom 2 lose points.[/p][p]④ Powerful buffs (e.g., healing, attack boosts) spawn periodically. Seize them to gain advantages![/p][p]⑤ Ranking rewards are settled monthly. Participate in all three branches, but only the highest Rank reward can be claimed once across all branches (no duplicate rewards).[/p][p]⑥ First 10 daily battles grant Honor and drop rewards (exchangeable in the Domination Store). Beyond 10 battles, no rewards but Rank points are earned.[/p][p]⑦ Weekly participation milestones unlock additional task rewards.[/p][p]"⑧ Top 10 players receive limited-time titles:[/p][p]Rank 1: Chief Title;[/p][p]Ranks 2-3: Vice-Chief Title;[/p][p]Ranks 4-10: Top 10 Title"[/p][p]Ⅱ. New Title System[/p][p]After obtaining a title, activate and equip it via your profile page. Some titles feature broadcast functionality—when entering battlefields or forming teams, all players will be notified.[/p][p]New Titles (All titles are time-limited.):[/p][p]1. Chief Domination Rank 1 Title (with broadcast feature)[/p][p]2. Chief Domination Ranks 2-3 Title (with broadcast feature)[/p][p]3. Chief Domination Ranks 4-10 Title[/p][p]4. Chief Domination Participation Title (complete weekly Domination tasks to claim)[/p][p]Ⅲ. New Commander Supply[/p][p]To help commanders more easily obtain commanders and their development materials, this update introduces the Commander Supply feature. Supply Coupons can be acquired through events and the in-game store.[/p][p]Commander Supply Pool Details:[/p][p]1. Pool Contents:[/p][p]① Complete Commanders[/p][p]② Commander Memory Pages[/p][p]③ Commander Advancement Medals[/p][p]④ Commander Upgrade Materials[/p][p]⑤ Commander Points[/p][p]2. Base Reward: Every 10-draw guarantees a random commander from the pool.[/p][p]3. Themed Event: Each event features a themed commander. Reaching the 10-draw count guarantees the current themed commander.[/p][p]4. Score Store: Participate in supplies to earn Commander Points, which can be used to purchase corresponding items.[/p][p]Ⅳ. Command Post Fusion[/p][p]To allow commanders to utilize better equipment attributes, this update introduces the Command Post Equipment Fusion feature.[/p][p]2. Two max-tier red 5★ equipment pieces of the same slot can be fused together—designated as Primary Equipment and Material Equipment. One attribute from the Material Equipment can be transferred to the Main Equipment. After successful fusion, the Material Equipment is destroyed.[/p][p]2. Each Material Equipment can only transfer one attribute. Without using Fusion Protection Materials, fusion failure will destroy the Material Equipment.[/p][p]3. Fusion success rates vary based on the color (rarity) of the transferred attribute. During fusion, Fusion Protection can be applied to safeguard the Material Equipment—if fusion fails, the Material Equipment is not destroyed. After accumulating a certain number of attempts, the next fusion is guaranteed to succeed.[/p][p]Note: Fusion Protection Materials can be purchased in the Trade Store or acquired via packages. Commanders should carefully read the feature instructions and fuse cautiously![/p][p]V. Strategy[/p][p]This update adds 5 new layers to the Commander Strategy.[/p][p]Ⅵ. Legion Optimizations[/p][p]This update brings the following optimizations to the Legion system:[/p][p]1. Increased capacity for resource distribution[/p][p]2. Resource distribution records now reset weekly (cleared when Legion Boss refreshes)[/p][p]3. Vice Legion Commanders now have the authority to expel members[/p][p]4. Added Legion disband function: Legion Commanders can choose to disband the Legion. Legions Level 9 and below will automatically disband if all members are inactive for 14 days.[/p][p]5. Legion Boss challenges are limited to one team at a time. Other teams can challenge only after the current team exits.[/p][p]Ⅶ. Other Optimizations[/p][p]1. Optimized Painting Store's texture and model buttons for easier switching between textures and models.[/p][p]2. Guaranteed orange or red blueprint in every 10-draw blueprint supply.[/p][p]3. Duplicate commanders will no longer be converted into Advancement Medals but into an equal amount of Memory Pages. The functionality for using Memory Pages will be introduced later.[/p][p]4. Added preparation features to the Legion War team formation page.[/p][p]5. Added preparation features to the Brawl matchmaking page.[/p][p]6. Fixed other known issues.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: "Tank Arena" August 4th Update Notice
notes.content: [p]Dear Commander,[/p][p]"Tank Arena" servers will undergo maintenance for an update on [b]August 4th, 2025, at 15:00 (server time)[/b]. The process is expected to take [b]5 hours[/b], during which the game will be temporarily unavailable.[/p][p]This update includes [b]gameplay optimizations and new event content[/b]. We appreciate your patience and support. Thank you, and enjoy the game![/p][p] [/p][p]I. MLRS Adjustments[/p][p]To align with MLRS vehicles' battlefield role, this update optimizes MLRS series with positioning enhancements and matchmaking rule adjustments (now allowing ±1 MLRS per match):[/p][p]1. MLRS Changes:[/p][p]① New Weapon: Deployable Emitter that drops repair kits (30s duration). Allies triggering kits restore durability.[/p][p]② Increased vehicle durability[/p][p]③ Increased vehicle speed[/p][p]④ Reduced MLRS weapon damage[/p][p]⑤ Reduced MLRS range[/p][p]2. Howitzer Changes:[/p][p]① New Weapon: Mortar that creates AOE damage with Armor Broken effect (reduces enemy armor strength).[/p][p]② Increased vehicle durability[/p][p]③ Increased vehicle speed[/p][p]④ Reduced howitzer damage[/p][p]⑤ Reduced howitzer range[/p][p]Weapon Acquisition: Emitters/Mortars available via Logistic Weapon Supply and Limited bundles in event.[/p][p]Upgrade materials: Ranked Honor Store and direct purchases.[/p][p] [/p][p]Ⅱ. Rank Mode Updates[/p][p]1. Rank teaming: Weekend events (Sat-Sun) now allow dual same-type vehicles (Tank/AFV only).[/p][p]2. Honor Hall: Monthly vehicle usage counters reset after lock-in.[/p][p]3. Deserter penalty: Hero-tier deserters lose 2★.[/p][p]4. Loss protection: Reduced star loss scales with consecutive defeats.[/p][p]5. Rank first win: Increased from 1 to 3 wins/day.[/p][p]6. Season timing: Ends on month’s penultimate day (Feb: 28 days).[/p][p]7. AFK detection: Improved decision rules.[/p][p] [/p][p]Ⅲ. New Warrant[/p][p]1. 2025 Season 3 Rank Warrant[/p][p]2. August Rank Warrant[/p][p]3. Peak Warrant: Added past painting purchases (duplicates convert to 1000 coating; flags/decals to 300 coating).[/p][p]Note: Rank Warrant weekly missions reset monthly (4-week cycles).*[/p][p] [/p][p]Ⅳ. Cross-Server Endless Battle[/p][p]Added cross-server teaming for Endless Battle. CN-server players can now team up via dedicated channels for bonus rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]Ⅴ. Ranked Maps[/p][p]All ranked maps are now available.[/p][p] [/p][p]Ⅵ. Other Optimizations[/p][p]1. Endless Mode: Server errors no longer consume attempt counts.[/p][p]2. Fixed tank auto-minelaying bugs.[/p][p]3. Fixed sporadic second Commander skill failures.[/p][p]4. Other known issues resolved.[/p][p] [/p]

tags.feature: ① New Weapon: Deployable Emitter that drops repair kits (30s duration). Allies triggering kits restore durability.
② New Weapon: Mortar that creates AOE damage with Armor Broken effect (reduces enemy armor strength).
Rank teaming: Weekend events (Sat-Sun) now allow dual same-type vehicles (Tank/AFV only).

tags.balance_change: 4. Loss protection: Reduced star loss scales with consecutive defeats.
5. Rank first win: Increased from 1 to 3 wins/day.

tags.feature: 3. Peak Warrant: Added past painting purchases (duplicates convert to 1000 coating; flags/decals to 300 coating).
Added cross-server teaming for Endless Battle. CN-server players can now team up via dedicated channels for bonus rewards.
All ranked maps are now available.

tags.bug: 3. Fixed sporadic second Commander skill failures.

notes.title: The brand-new competitive version
notes.content:
What's new:
Ⅰ. New Maintenance system
To provide commanders with a more convenient way to set up battle strategies, the new Maintenance System has been introduced. This system allows for free customization of various in-game elements, automatically activating corresponding attributes for the selected vehicle type.
1. Entry: The original Pre war preparation has been renamed to Maintenance
2. Maintenance pages: There are six pages available (four unlocked for free). You can rename pages and configure them as follows:
①Tech
②Strategy
③Command Post
④Military Soul
⑤Commander
⑥Officer
⑦Customization: avatar frame, title, business card, kill broadcasts, kill effect
3. After saving the settings, the selected Maintenance will be displayed on the main Maintenance page. During battle, the game will automatically activate the maintenance matching the selected vehicle type.
Note: If no customized maintenance is configured, the system will default to the player's existing settings.

Ⅱ. New Multi-vehicle Match in Rank mode
This update introduces multi-vehicle selection for rank match. You can now queue with multiple vehicle types, and the system will select the most suitable vehicle based on battlefield needs.
"How to set up backup behicles: 
Entry Point: ""ackup Vehicles button in the lower right corner of Rank Mode and Team Lobby screens."
Note: Besides the default vehicle, each type can have only one additional backup vehicle. Do not select a backup vehicle that matches the default vehicle type; otherwise, matchm will be disabled.

Ⅲ. New Rank Point Pool
The Rank Points Pool has been added to reward MVP performances after battles. MVP points earned in battle will be converted into Rank points (maximum 200 points per match).Once the pool reaches 1,000 points, it will be converted into Rank progress.
1. Point conversion by Rank:
Bronze: +30 points
Silver: +25 points
Gold: +20 points
Platinum: +15 points
Diamond: +10 points
King: +5 points
Hero: +1 star
2. Players who activate the Honor Challenge will receive a 1.5x point boost when using different vehicle types (up to two).

Ⅳ. SVP rewards upgrade for Rank mode
Players below 2400 points who earn SVP in the losing team will now receive bonus rank points. Players above 2400 points with SVP will not lose a star.

Ⅴ. Boss Vault
The third boss in the Secret Vault event is now available.
Boss Details: BMP-3S Soul War Chariot
Skills:
1. Thermobaric Bomb: Every 30 seconds, targets a random allied vehicle and marks them for 5 seconds. Upon detonation, deals 30,000 damage over a 900m radius, which can be shared among nearby players.
2. Pulse Shield: Every 90 seconds, activates a shield that reflects 100% damage from a random weapon type (including Cannons, Rockets, MGs, Autocannons, and Missiles). The shield must be destroyed within 60 seconds to prevent a 15,000 AoE damage explosion.
3. Legion Reinforcements: Every time the boss loses 30% HP, it becomes invincible, summons smoke cover, and calls in enemy reinforcements. Players must eliminate these units to remove the boss’s invulnerability.
Battle Tips:
1. Thermobaric Bomb: Stack near the marked player to share damage, or use invincibility skills.
2. Pulse Shield: Use weapons not affected by the reflection effect to break the shield quickly.
2. Legion Reinforcements: Clear all summoned enemies as fast as possible to remove the boss's invincibility.

Ⅵ. Weapon Synthesis system
A weapon synthesis system has been added, allowing players to upgrade existing weapons into higher-tier versions. The weapons used are divided into core weapons and material weapons. When synthesizing, core weapons have a chance to be promoted to high-level weapons. If they fail, they will retain the core weapons and destroy the material weapons. At the same time, the luck progress will be increased. After the luck progress is full, the target weapon will be obtained.
There are two types of high-level target weapons: the first type is Fiesta weapons, and the second type is Epic, Warlord or Grand weapons.
1. When synthesizing Fiesta weapons, you need to use any of the same type of Epic, Warlord or Grand weapons as core weapons, and use other weapons as material weapons. The system will set different success probabilities and failure luck points according to the grade of the material weapons used (modified, remoulded, ordinary) and the degree of rarity.
2. When synthesizing Epic, Warlord or Grand weapons, you need to use the same type of Military, Sundry, and other modified weapons as core weapons, and use other weapons as material weapons. The system will set different success probabilities and failure luck points according to the grade of the material weapons used (modified, remoulded, and ordinary).
Note1: Successful synthesis inherits modifications and enhancements from the core weapon.
Note2: Luck Value resets to zero upon successful synthesis.

Ⅶ. Vehicle Workshop
The Hero series has been a fan favorite, and now, the Hero·Ultra/Glory series is officially launching!
99-Hero & Golden 99-Hero can now be upgraded to Ultra/Glory via the Vehicle Workshop. M-ATVS has been added to the Vehicle Workshop.

Ⅷ. New Rank mode maps
Remove: Narrows Plain, Sicily Bay, Silent Mountains, Rocky Mountains.
Release: Rhine Valley, El Alamein, Kiev, Geirangerfjorden, Rostov-on-Don, Armenia, Kursk, Volokolamsk Icefield.

Ⅱ. New Multi-vehicle Match in Rank mode
This update introduces multi-vehicle selection for rank match. You can now queue with multiple vehicle types, and the system will select the most suitable vehicle based on battlefield needs.
"How to set up backup behicles: 
Entry Point: ""ackup Vehicles button in the lower right corner of Rank Mode and Team Lobby screens."
Note: Besides the default vehicle, each type can have only one additional backup vehicle. Do not select a backup vehicle that matches the default vehicle type; otherwise, matchm will be disabled.

Ⅲ. New Rank Point Pool
The Rank Points Pool has been added to reward MVP performances after battles. MVP points earned in battle will be converted into Rank points (maximum 200 points per match).Once the pool reaches 1,000 points, it will be converted into Rank progress.
1. Point conversion by Rank:
Bronze: +30 points
Silver: +25 points
Gold: +20 points
Platinum: +15 points
Diamond: +10 points
King: +5 points
Hero: +1 star
2. Players who activate the Honor Challenge will receive a 1.5x point boost when using different vehicle types (up to two).

Ⅳ. SVP rewards upgrade for Rank mode
Players below 2400 points who earn SVP in the losing team will now receive bonus rank points. Players above 2400 points with SVP will not lose a star.

Ⅴ. Boss Vault
The third boss in the Secret Vault event is now available.
Boss Details: BMP-3S Soul War Chariot
Skills:
1. Thermobaric Bomb: Every 30 seconds, targets a random allied vehicle and marks them for 5 seconds. Upon detonation, deals 30,000 damage over a 900m radius, which can be shared among nearby players.
2. Pulse Shield: Every 90 seconds, activates a shield that reflects 100% damage from a random weapon type (including Cannons, Rockets, MGs, Autocannons, and Missiles). The shield must be destroyed within 60 seconds to prevent a 15,000 AoE damage explosion.
3. Legion Reinforcements: Every time the boss loses 30% HP, it becomes invincible, summons smoke cover, and calls in enemy reinforcements. Players must eliminate these units to remove the boss’s invulnerability.
Battle Tips:
1. Thermobaric Bomb: Stack near the marked player to share damage, or use invincibility skills.
2. Pulse Shield: Use weapons not affected by the reflection effect to break the shield quickly.
2. Legion Reinforcements: Clear all summoned enemies as fast as possible to remove the boss's invincibility.

Ⅵ. Weapon Synthesis system
A weapon synthesis system has been added, allowing players to upgrade existing weapons into higher-tier versions. The weapons used are divided into core weapons and material weapons. When synthesizing, core weapons have a chance to be promoted to high-level weapons. If they fail, they will retain the core weapons and destroy the material weapons. At the same time, the luck progress will be increased. After the luck progress is full, the target weapon will be obtained.
There are two types of high-level target weapons: the first type is Fiesta weapons, and the second type is Epic, Warlord or Grand weapons.
1. When synthesizing Fiesta weapons, you need to use any of the same type of Epic, Warlord or Grand weapons as core weapons, and use other weapons as material weapons. The system will set different success probabilities and failure luck points according to the grade of the material weapons used (modified, remoulded, ordinary) and the degree of rarity.
2. When synthesizing Epic, Warlord or Grand weapons, you need to use the same type of Military, Sundry, and other modified weapons as core weapons, and use other weapons as material weapons. The system will set different success probabilities and failure luck points according to the grade of the material weapons used (modified, remoulded, and ordinary).
Note1: Successful synthesis inherit modifications and enhancements from the core weapon.
Note2: Luck Value resets to zero upon successful synthesis.

Ⅶ. Vehicle Workshop
The Hero series has been a fan favorite, and now, the Hero·Ultra/Glory series is officially launching!
99-Hero & Golden 99-Hero can now be upgraded to Ultra/Glory via the Vehicle Workshop. M-ATVS has been added to the Vehicle Workshop.

Ⅷ. New Rank mode maps
Remove: Narrows Plain, Sicily Bay, Silent Mountains, Rocky Mountains.
Release: Rhine Valley, El Alamein, Kiev, Geirangerfjorden, Rostov-on-Don, Armenia, Kursk, Volokolamsk Icefield.
